commands: # Get all VPCs and instances in each region for region in us-east-1 us-west-1 us-west-2; do echo "=== Region: $region ===" echo "VPCs:" aws ec2 describe-vpcs --region $region --output json | jq -r '.Vpcs[] | "\(.VpcId) \(.CidrBlock)"' echo "" echo "Instances by VPC:" aws ec2 describe-instances --region $region --output json --query 'Reservations[].Instances[].{InstanceId:InstanceId,VpcId:VpcId,State:State.Name}' | jq -r '.[] | "\(.InstanceId) (VPC: \(.VpcId), State: \(.State))"' echo "" done
